acceptance_test_interpretation: The source receipt tests closed artifact topology, extractor agreement, and all-life feasibility, but not recovery of missing prompts or native runtime writer semantics. The tokenizer receipt tests identical continuation labels, masks, ordering, and updates; it does not establish equal total-token exposure, positions, or FLOPs. The sealing receipt tests manifest-before-exposure ordering, complete contamination handling, content-hash exclusion, constructibility, and deterministic panel agreement without scoring. The canary receipt tests duplicate training and serving determinism for both trained paths, the common base path, and zero-delta adapter equivalence, with failure requiring a new design. The primary contrast measures the exact neutral-chat-prefix package against BOS-only training on strict first-action value and marker retention, not a chat-boundary mechanism. The baseline contrast measures the complete post-hoc selected-corpus package against one common frozen base and is descriptive across three source lives, not population inference. The claim review checks that reports remain limited to those two package-level contrasts and explicitly reject task conditioning, verification causality, discovery, learned THINK, parenting, continual improvement, and flywheel interpretations.

assumptions: The supplied change artifact and listed context hashes are the authoritative proposal bytes; no implementation files or unlisted runtime artifacts are consulted.
The three source lives are B0, B1, and B2, with the completed wake-256 prefix and immediately succeeding wake as the only extraction boundary.
The selected continuation corpus is an artifact-defined, post-hoc historical sample. It is not a prospective sample and cannot support population-level inference.
C1 and C2 adapters are independent per-life rank-16 artifacts trained only after later exact ratification; they are not mounted into or written back to the historical lives.
The target panel contains 64 ordered content-disjoint programs, and the one-decision evaluation uses a fresh reset, greedy generation, strict parsing, and no retry.
The word dream denotes a later organism-scale processing opportunity in the thesis; the present extraction is only a bounded historical re-expression preparation step.
claim_delta_interpretation: The proposal narrows the scientific claim from an absent prospective test to two bounded descriptive estimands. C2-minus-C0 is the total effect of training a per-life LoRA on the post-hoc selected continuation corpus and then serving it through the frozen interface on fresh target programs. C2-minus-C1 is the effect of the exact neutral-chat-prefix training package relative to BOS-only training, with target tokens and update ordinals matched but positions, context, total tokens, and FLOPs not matched. Neither contrast identifies source task conditioning, verified outcome binding, novel actions, learned THINK, parenting, continual improvement, or recurrent experience learning. A negative result is a failure of this fixed corpus/package to clear its fixed strict-action and interface floors, not evidence against future organism learning.

disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Interpret the evaluation-to-future-cycle edge as a report reference and possible future design input only; it must not be activated by this assay or by model/reviewer agreement.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The loop stop condition and human boundary explicitly prohibit feeding scores, actions, adapters, prompts, or results into a life. Treating the edge as active would contradict the visibility and authority contract.
disagreements_with_proposal.statement: I disagree with any operational reading in which the added future-dream node makes this assay recurrent. The current assay terminates at reporting.

disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Call C1/C2 writes assay-local parametric transport or writer reinforcement. Reserve whole-organism consolidation credit for a separately approved lifecycle in which the organism's own recurrent interfaces use the state.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The adapters are independently trained from frozen historical rows, evaluated without retrieval or revision, and never installed into the running lives under the current boundary.
disagreements_with_proposal.statement: I disagree with crediting the C1/C2 adapter artifacts themselves as organism-scale consolidation, even though they are parametric state in the assay.

graph_delta_interpretation: The lifetime graph begins with the preserved lived organism: bootstrap-driven generation produces thought, PREDICT, ACT, NOTE, and DONE behavior; the gym executes ACT payloads and returns instruction outcomes; raw thought, act, note, wake-manifest, and outcome records form the historical episode archive. The new snapshot node copies immutable B0/B1/B2 bytes through wake 256 plus a successor fence, retaining raw offsets and hashes while changing no live process, ledger, adapter, or prompt. The extractor then operates only on artifact topology: it partitions each program stream into every maximal act/note run, including leading, interior, and trailing groups; attaches groups only to immediate compatible thoughts; and emits occurrences, candidate edges, exclusions, and a unique assignment or a fail-closed rejection. It derives terminal offsets, continuation hashes, exact action payload checks, outcome checks, prior-improvement checks, and birth-payload diagnostics. Notes remain declarative provenance but are excluded from training targets; invalid rows, ambiguous joins, duplicates, promptless reconstruction attempts, post-fence bytes, and other rejected evidence are discarded from eligibility while reasons remain in receipts. The selected corpus is per-life and never pooled before training. C1 writes an independent LoRA from BOS plus target continuations; C2 writes an independent LoRA from the frozen neutral-chat prefix plus the identical continuation target IDs and EOS labels. These are parametric writer states, not retrieval records or edits to a life. A separately ratified manifest binds later sealing, training, serving, parsing, and reporting. Only after that boundary can two blind sealers construct and hash a 64-program content-disjoint panel. C0, C1, and C2 then converge on a fresh one-decision evaluator with identical target input IDs, strict ACT dispatch, a fresh environment reset, and no cross-program state. The output is a score/marker report and bounded diagnostics, not a live-organism update. The graph therefore adds provenance, corpus, adapter, seal, and evaluator nodes while deliberately omitting retrieval, multi-step planning, revision, and feedback edges from the active assay. Dream-like breadth growth is not actually implemented: the attachment graph creates local physical/provenance connections only, not semantic associative expansion. Thinking is a single goal-conditioned generation path that may emit one executable ACT, not a constructed multi-step plan.

loop_delta_interpretation: At organism scale, lived action and environment outcomes remain eligible inputs to a future dream relationship, but only through a future separately approved cycle. This assay instead reads a frozen historical snapshot once. The source-attachment loop is bounded by the prefix-plus-fence bytes and iterates until every permitted row is assigned or explicitly excluded, requiring unique one-to-one group/thought attachment and agreement between extractors; any ambiguity, invalidity, interleaving, or feasibility failure stops the life closed. The parametric-transport loop is not recurrent self-training: after later ratification, each of the three frozen per-life corpora is passed exactly three times through its C1 and C2 recipe, with deterministic update ordering and fail-closed validation. The evaluation loop runs once per sealed target and cell, with a 256-token generation budget, greedy sampling, one strict first-action opportunity, fresh environment reset, no retrieval, no revision, no retry, and no cross-program ledger. It stops after the finite panel completes or a ratified failure condition occurs. There is no active loop from evaluation back to corpus, adapter, live process, retrieval, or dream in this change. Thinker attempts and outcomes from the original lived episodes can become evidence for a later dream only after they have been persisted in the organism's eligible archive and a separately approved future dream cycle consumes them; outputs of this assay are reporting-only until that same kind of future authorization boundary.
system_thesis_interpretation: The proposal preserves a recurrent organism thesis but isolates one writer/transport assay from the recurrence. In a normal lifetime, the agent observes a goal and environment, generates thought and marker lines, dispatches an ACT through the executable gym interface, observes the resulting instruction outcome, and records declarative episode material. Dream-time processing may later re-express retained episode material and prepare parametric state, while later goal-directed thinking may retrieve and compose it. Here, observation is historical ledger and manifest bytes plus recorded action/outcome fields; retrieval is intentionally absent at training and evaluation; derivation is restricted to artifact joins, continuation eligibility, tokenization, hashes, scores, and diagnostics; writing is limited to immutable audit artifacts, per-life corpus receipts, and—only after later approval—independent LoRA artifacts and reports. Explicit declarative state consists of raw ledgers, thoughts, notes, actions, outcomes, manifests, provenance, exclusions, and target-seal records. LoRA weights and optimizer/loss artifacts are parametric state. Temporary state consists of extractor candidate graphs, tokenizer batches, training activations, serving generations, parser candidates, and fresh environment episodes; none becomes retrieval memory here. The assay discards invalid or ambiguous historical evidence, notes as training targets, duplicate continuations, fence data as eligible training rows, contaminated or aliased target content, and all feedback into the lives. The historical attachment operation resembles local dream-time connection-making only in the weak sense of recovering bounded physical adjacency; it does not grow a broad semantic memory graph. The evaluation generation resembles goal-directed thinking but is deliberately truncated to one decision, one strict ACT dispatch, and no planning or revision. Module-level credit belongs to the complete mounted cell and its serving/parser/environment path, with C2-versus-C1 isolating only the exact input-package contrast and C2-versus-C0 covering the complete selected-corpus training package. Whole-organism credit is withheld because the assay removes retrieval, multi-step action, revision, live feedback, and recurrent self-training. Scale is three historical lives, at least 64 unique rows and 4,096 target tokens per life, three training passes, and a 64-program sealed panel; these are formative finite thresholds, not replication of an organism population.
visibility_matrix_interpretation: Visibility moves monotonically from raw evidence to bounded derived artifacts and then narrows again. Raw legacy bytes and prompt absence are visible during snapshot and extraction, reduced to hashes and receipt references for manifest/reporting, hidden from target sealing, forbidden to training and evaluation, and reportable only as audit-derived facts. Selected continuations and birth-payload tags become visible only after extraction, are bound by hashes and row order in the manifest, forbidden from target selection and evaluation, and exposed to training only as frozen continuation targets; birth tags remain diagnostic and cannot select rows or adapters. Manifest design bytes are derived or visible to the relevant later role and are the authority for sealers, trainers, serving, parser, and reporting. Target content is forbidden until the manifest is ratified, visible to blind sealers and the target renderer during evaluation, and reduced to permitted identifiers or hashes afterward. Scores and actions do not exist as target-sealing inputs; source outcomes may support provenance only, while evaluation outcomes appear only in the evaluator/report stage. Adapter and loss artifacts do not exist during snapshot/extraction, are created and visible within training, and are exposed to serving only by approved identity, hashes, and outcomes. Aggregate results and claims are hidden before execution, unavailable to training and sealing, produced by evaluation, and visible for bounded reporting only after claim-boundary review. The matrix therefore prevents source-memory leakage into targets, target leakage into training, and evaluation feedback into any active learning loop.
